item.title: February 2026 New Releases
item.description: Learn about the new and notable resources, including Saved to Sin No More by Brad Wetherell and That Holy Week So Long Ago by Matthew Boswell.

item.title: What Is Fasting?
item.description: Our spiritual appetites need a recalibration so that we find pleasure in Christ instead of in the world’s offerings. The solution isn’t to pursue what this world can offer but to seek what truly nourishes.

item.title: Setting the Stage for the Four Gospels
item.description: The four Gospels contain eyewitness accounts (and first-hand reports) of the life, death, and resurrection of Jesus.

item.title: If I’m Saved by Grace, Why Fight Sin?
item.description: Having been justified, we are now being sanctified. And God’s sanctifying grace makes continuing in sin—willfully and unrepentantly—illogical, inappropriate, and ultimately impossible.

item.title: Podcast: What Union with Christ Means for Your Fight Against Sin (Brad Wetherell)
item.description: Brad Wetherell discusses the transforming doctrine of union with Christ, reminding believers that this reality brings hope to every area of their lives.

item.title: The Greatest Problem with Our Shame
item.description: For most of my life, when I heard the word “shame” in the Bible or in life around me, I instinctively interpreted it as guilt. I thought of it as a strong synonym for guilt: guilt on steroids.

item.title: Introducing ‘The Biggest Story Curriculum, Easter Lessons’
item.description: 4 complete Easter lessons for K–5, designed to use as a stand-alone or as part of The Biggest Story Curriculum.

item.title: What God Is Doing While You Wait for Your Prayer to Be Answered
item.description: In Matthew 6:10, we’re given clarity on our prayers and how God answers. He might not answer the way we want him to, but he always gives us his best.

item.title: Crossway+ Special: Buy One Get One Books to Read with a Friend
item.description: An exclusive offer for Crossway+ members to buy one books at 30% off and get another one for free to read alongside a friend.

item.title: How to Repent of Sin and Rejoice in Christ Together with a Discipleship Group
item.description: How can we fight the good fight of faith? I want to explain the concept of “discipleship groups” as a way for all disciples to fight for what is noble and beautiful.
